name: A Second Chance
source:
After taking a (mostly unproductive) gap year full of barely any social contact, you finally decide to go to university. The perfect opportunity for a new start and a great way to improve your social skills! The only problem is that the university of your dreams is really far away from where you live with your parents. So the only solution is to move out.

After a lot of searching, you finally find someone who is renting out a room for a really low price. And after arriving at your new home, you are greeted by a beautiful woman and her two gorgeous daughters. Time to put those social skills to good use! Who knows what could happen...

But ever since you've arrived in your new home, you've begun to experience some weird flashes. Could it be just a coincidence, or is there something else going on?

[From [url=https://radondy.itch.io/a-second-chance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在经历了几乎没有任何社交接触的间隔年（大部分是毫无成效的）之后，你终于决定去大学。这是一个新的开始的绝佳机会，也是提高社交技能的好方法！唯一的问题是你梦想的大学离你和父母住的地方真的很远。所以唯一的解决办法就是搬出去。

经过一番寻找，你终于找到了一个以非常低的价格出租房间的人。到达你的新家后，迎接你的是一位美丽的女人和她的两个漂亮的女儿。是时候充分利用这些社交技能了！谁知道会发生什么……

但自从你到达新家后，你就开始经历一些奇怪的闪光。难道这只是巧合，还是另有原因？

[来自[url=https://radondy.itch.io/a-second-chance]itch.io[/url]]
